title: Automate invoice processing for the company
outcome: Every incoming invoice is captured, validated, and paid without manual data entry.
constraints: All invoice data stays inside the company Paperclip instance.
Payment execution always requires a human approver.

terminalEvidence.description: The final ledger report matches the accounting export for two consecutive months.

phases.objective: Capture every invoice into a normalized queue.
Validate queued invoices against the ledger.
